name: Thijs Reuten, Nina Carberry - Après le § 244 - Am 3
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU-UK Trade and Cooperation Agreement
part_text: 244a. Stresses that the growing scale of illegal crossings of the English Channel poses a major challenge to the internal security of the EU and its Member States; considers that EU-UK cooperation can only produce tangible results if it is based on clear operational commitments, systematic information exchange and joint action to dismantle criminal networks; stresses the need to maximise the effectiveness of returns to countries of origin; recalls that any progress in other areas of the EU-UK partnership should be accompanied by concrete progress in the fight against illegal immigration and smuggling networks;
